short: Local divisibility test for integral forms

lean.name: Formalism.MainNotions.LocalQuadraticParts.adm2
lean.plain: Local divisibility test for integral forms
lean.note: For a form in the unscaled lattice and an allowed integral test vector, a nonzero period has valuation at least $\lfloor e_\lambda g(u,\lambda)\rfloor$ at $\lambda$. That is the threshold needed to multiply the form by the rescaling ideal while keeping its periods integral.
